title.en: Show B.AI Credits balance in dsh-cost-meter
title.zh: 在 dsh-cost-meter 中显示 B.AI 代币余额（Credits）

description.en: Displays the B.AI account balance as integer Credits (the platform's native unit) in dsh-cost-meter's sidebar card and Cost settings row. No division, no FX conversion.
description.zh: 把 B.AI 账户余额按整数 Credits（平台原生单位）显示在 dsh-cost-meter 的侧边栏卡片与费用设置页；不做除法、不做汇率折算。

unitNotes.native: data.personal_balance is an integer Credits count. 1 USD = 1,000,000 Credits (billing rate); 1 Coin = 1,000,000 Credits (Coin -> Credits exchange). Credits have no CNY peg.
unitNotes.rendering: With unit CREDITS the plugin prints the plain number plus the suffix ' Credits' (no currency symbol, trailing zeros trimmed, no thousands separator).

label.zh: 美元等值（可选，派生值：1 USD = 1,000,000 Credits）

apply.identityMatch: exact, case-insensitive; trailing slashes on request.url ignored
steps: Resolve DSH_HOME (defaults to ~/.dsh) and the ledger path from apply.path.
Read and parse the ledger JSON; abort if the array named by apply.pointer already holds maxEntries entries and no entry matches apply.identityFields.
Back up ledger.json next to itself with a timestamp suffix.
Update the matching entry in place, or append the new one; keep every {{VAR}} placeholder literal.
When updating, carry the existing entry's credential-header placeholder over (preserveCredentialBinding) so a working key binding is never silently re-pointed.

Report which placeholders already resolve from the credential store or the environment; if one is missing, tell the user to paste the key into the plugin's Credential input, then refresh the browser page.

credential.namingConvention: <ROUTE>_API_KEY, where <ROUTE> is the provider id on Settings -> Models (uppercased, non-alphanumerics replaced by _). Reuse the same variable name as an existing B.AI model provider to share one stored key.
howToStore: Preferred: the plugin's Credential input box on the entry (write-only, stored in the DSH credential store).
Alternative: the DSH credential store, whose shape is a nested mapping (2+ spaces of indentation under refs:), e.g. `version: 1` / `refs:` / `  BAI_API_KEY: <key>` — never commit that file.
Fallback: the BAI_API_KEY environment variable in the process running DSH.
credential.neverCommit: Never place a literal API key in ledger.json, this preset, or any commit.

verification.successField: Use the top-level `success` field, not the HTTP status: a failed lookup can be HTTP 200 with success=false.

teamKeys.reason: Team keys omit data.personal_balance. member_quota_limit is present only when quota_limit_type === "limited"; team_balance only for the admin role. Untested, derived from the API docs.
